name: socialcrawl-superengine
description: Deep social research superengine on the SocialCrawl API: the full 43-platform / 333-endpoint canon with exact per-call credits, plus guided research plays — voice-of-customer mining, competitor ad-library recon, AI-visibility (GEO) audits, link-in-bio offer mapping, audience demographics, dev/tool radar — and hard-gated big-gun one-shots (creator vetting, lead discovery, share-of-voice). Bring-your-own key; every paid call is cost-gated up front. Pairs with the RevXL format engines (they detect it and unlock deep plays) or runs standalone.
